.env.example:
# --- Database (Postgres: Neon, Supabase, Vercel Postgres, or your own) ---
# Leave empty for local preview: an embedded database is created under .data/
DATABASE_URL=

# --- Sign-in (Google OAuth, Auth.js) ---
AUTH_SECRET=                 # openssl rand -base64 32
AUTH_GOOGLE_ID=
AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET=
# Who may sign in: exact addresses and/or whole domains (comma-separated)
ALLOWED_EMAILS=
ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS=
# Managers can change channels, tags and targets. Defaults to ALLOWED_EMAILS.
# Domain-wide users are read-only unless explicitly listed here.
ADMIN_EMAILS=
# Local preview only (ignored in production): skip sign-in
AUTH_DISABLED=false

# --- YouTube Data API v3 ---
# One key for every channel (public stats only); no per-channel key is needed.
YOUTUBE_API_KEY=
# Channels added automatically on the first sync (comma-separated @handles, IDs or URLs)
YOUTUBE_CHANNELS=@TeamSecret,@TeamSecretLOL,@TeamSecretAOV

# --- TikTok for Developers (Login Kit + Display API) ---
TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=
TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET=
TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI=https://your-app.example.com/api/tiktok/callback
# Encrypts TikTok tokens in the database: openssl rand -base64 32
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY=

# --- Scheduler ---
# The scheduler calls /api/cron/poll with "Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>"
CRON_SECRET=                 # openssl rand -hex 32

# --- Google Sheet export ---
# Key for /api/export/sheet (read-only feed used by the team's Google Sheet): openssl rand -hex 32
SHEET_EXPORT_KEY=
.github/workflows/poll.yml:
# Triggers a data sync every 10 minutes. GitHub schedules are best-effort and can
# run a few minutes late; use Vercel Cron (Pro) or cron-job.org for tighter timing.
# Repository secrets needed: APP_URL (https://your-app...) and CRON_SECRET.
name: Poll channel stats

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/10 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  poll:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 6
    steps:
      - name: Call the poll endpoint
        env:
          APP_URL: ${{ secrets.APP_URL }}
          CRON_SECRET: ${{ secrets.CRON_SECRET }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$APP_URL" ] || [ -z "$CRON_SECRET" ]; then
            echo "APP_URL / CRON_SECRET secrets are not set; skipping."
            exit 1
          fi
          response=$(curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 300 \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" "$APP_URL/api/cron/poll")
          echo "$response" | jq -e '(.accountsFailed // 0) == 0 and ((.errors // []) | length) == 0' > /dev/null
